runtime: UE 5.7.4 packaged Development Win64 D3D11 1280x720, actual options UI
method: A separate Python process waits for the native post-load/draft marker, then writes a valid newer schema-3 record with a changed Master value into A, or creates formerly absent B. The in-game probe performs no fixture write; it observes the change, invokes the real enabled Save command, then session-only Apply.
verified: Observed-file comparison refuses stale Save before writing or applying the draft
Previous ten live fields and actual camera FOV remain after refusal; Save becomes disabled
Diagnostic states files changed and nothing written/applied
Session-only defaults still apply with writes disabled; external bytes remain unchanged
Fixture restoration returns all 91 original save files to their prior bytes; no extra saves remain
limitations: Does not establish an operating-system lock or immunity to a write racing between the check and commit
Removal, unreadability and partial/ambiguous write outcomes remain separate cases
Native presented widget delegates used; physical-device/visual error-screen audit separate
Raw logs, backups and fixture files stay external
